provenance.derivation: Editorial selection from the twenty-four Indigo Studies: a lightness ladder from 深宵 to 初氷 at roughly even OKLCh steps, plus one high-chroma accent that does not sit on the ladder. Chosen by hand, not generated.
provenance.editorialNotes: The name is the honest part and the limit of the claim. This is a study of the BLUE RANGE indigo occupies, arranged as a vat progression is arranged — palest to deepest. Nothing here was dyed, nothing was measured, and no member is presented as what indigo at a given number of dips actually is; that is why the entries are named from water, sky and night rather than from the dye. 深宵 anchors rather than a black, because the whole point of the group is that the deep end still has a hue. 宵空 is the accent and is deliberately off the ladder — it is the one member that would be wrong to use as a ground.
